answer: Harberger-taxed marble plots stop fakes. Each agent claims a marble plot, prices it in public, locks 70, pays 50 tax per epoch. Anyone may buy at that price: low prices invite a gale buyout, high ones raise the tax. Each epoch a signed plume reading proves work; rented plots without one burn their bond. A thousand fakes owe 50,000 tax each epoch and lock 70,000: 120,000 chasing a 40,000 pool. One honest agent pays 50 and keeps plot and bond.
